is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluates vector densities of Anopheles gambiae s.l., An. arabiensis, and An. funestus s.l. in western Kenya (pages 462, 465).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions kdr (L1014S) in the introduction/background by citing previous published studies (e.g. Kawada et al. 2011), but does not genotype any resistance markers in the mosquitoes collected for this trial (page 462, page 468: 'Although we did not confirm species of the anophelines collected during the study period...').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No mosquito genotype counts or allele frequency data are reported in this paper. PCR was performed only for human malaria parasite detection (P. falciparum).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sentinel and cross-sectional household surveys in Gembe East, Homa Bay County, western Kenya (pages 462, 464).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary cluster randomized controlled trial evaluating PBO-LLINs versus standard LLINs.

sub_country_location.evidence: Gembe East of Homa Bay County, western Kenya, coordinates 0°30'24" S and 34°20'48" E (page 462).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Preintervention survey between April 2009 and February 2011; postintervention surveys between March 2011 and May 2012 (pages 462, 464).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Trial entomological collections are original, but no genotype data were produced or reported.

supplement.evidence: No missing supplementary marker genotype data exists because no marker genotyping was conducted.

assessment.summary: This cluster randomized controlled trial in western Kenya evaluated the efficacy of PBO-LLINs compared to standard LLINs on malaria vector density and Plasmodium falciparum prevalence. While Anopheles mosquitoes were collected and monitored, no target insecticide resistance markers were genotyped in this study; resistance mechanisms were only cited from previously published baseline literature.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype or report target insecticide-resistance markers in mosquitoes (reports_target_markers = false).
Does not contain extractable mosquito genotype data (reports_extractable_genotype_data = false).
